hook.name: TwinHook
hook.description: Fee-routing hook for stock-paired meme tokens ("twins") on Uniswap v4. Applies a decaying anti-snipe launch tax on buys, publishes a Chad Premium (current/launch price multiple), ratchets a Chad Level on confirmed price milestones, and dispatches creator LP fees to configurable sinks: burn (with buyback guard), reflection to holders, auto-LP, bonders yield pool, or direct payout.
